VELQORA PDF 10.3 — SOURCE CODE IN PLAIN TEXT
Files are separated by filename. Binary assets are excluded.
This is a reference export, not a runnable project.


========================================================================================
FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/.github/workflows/macos-intel.yml
========================================================================================
name: Build Velqora PDF Intel DMG
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: ['main', 'master']
    tags: ['v*']
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: macos-intel-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-15-intel
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '11.0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11.9'
          architecture: x64
      - name: Build, audit and test mounted DMG
        run: bash scripts/build_macos.sh
      - name: Save diagnostic logs even after a failed build
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Velqora-PDF-build-reports
          path: dist/reports/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Save verified DMG and checksum
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Velqora-PDF-macOS-Intel
          path: |
            dist/Velqora-PDF-2.1-macOS-Intel.dmg
            dist/SHA256SUMS
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/.github/workflows/velqora-release.yml

name: Velqora PDF 10.3 release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [.github/workflows/velqora-release.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  package:
    name: Build and verify ${{ matrix.edition }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            arch: x64
            edition: Intel
            filename: Velqora-PDF-10.3-macOS-Intel.dmg
          - runner: macos-15
            arch: arm64
            edition: AppleSilicon
            filename: Velqora-PDF-10.3-macOS-AppleSilicon.dmg
          - runner: windows-2022
            arch: x64
            edition: Windows-x64
            filename: Velqora-PDF-10.3-Windows-x64.zip
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11.9'
          architecture: ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Restore project and apply release changes
        shell: bash

          python -m zipfile -e Velqora-PDF-2.1-source.zip project

# PyInstaller build for the native macOS host architecture.
import platform
from pathlib import Path
from PyInstaller.utils.hooks import copy_metadata
root=Path(SPECPATH)
notices=[]
for name in ['PyMuPDF','PySide6','PySide6-Essentials','PySide6-Addons','shiboken6','Pillow']:
    notices+=copy_metadata(name)
a=Analysis([str(root/'src/main.py')],pathex=[str(root/'src')],
    datas=[(str(root/'assets'),'assets'),(str(root/'README.md'),'.'),(str(root/'LICENSE'),'.'),(str(root/'THIRD_PARTY.md'),'.')]+notices,
    hiddenimports=['fitz','pymupdf'],excludes=['PySide6.QtWebEngineCore','PySide6.QtWebEngineWidgets','numpy','tkinter'],noarchive=False)
pyz=PYZ(a.pure)
exe=EXE(pyz,a.scripts,[],exclude_binaries=True,name='Velqora PDF',console=False,target_arch=platform.machine())
coll=COLLECT(exe,a.binaries,a.datas,name='Velqora PDF')
app=BUNDLE(coll,name='Velqora PDF.app',icon=str(root/'assets/icon.icns'),bundle_identifier='org.velqora.pdf',
 info_plist={'CFBundleShortVersionString':'10.3.0','CFBundleVersion':'1030', 'LSMinimumSystemVersion':'11.0',
 'CFBundleDevelopmentRegion':'en','NSHighResolutionCapable':True,'CFBundleDocumentTypes':[{'CFBundleTypeName':'PDF document','CFBundleTypeRole':'Editor','LSItemContentTypes':['com.adobe.pdf'],'LSHandlerRank':'Alternate'}]})

# Velqora PDF 10.3 — Source Distribution

This archive combines the provided Velqora PDF source archives into a single package, including the Linux packaging scripts and bundled font assets. The source files and build scripts are preserved without modification.

## Licensing

The supplied `LICENSE` contains the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3. The supplied `README.md` states `AGPL-3.0-or-later`. See `THIRD_PARTY.md` and the license notices inside `assets/fonts/` and `assets/tessdata/` for third-party terms. Review all license and attribution requirements before public distribution.

## Layout

- `src/` — Python application source
- `tests/` — tests
- `scripts/` — build and verification scripts
- `.github/workflows/` — automation
- `linux-build/` — Linux packaging scripts and build configuration
- `assets/` — images, OCR data, and fonts (with accompanying license files)
- `requirements*.txt` — Python dependencies
- `LICENSE` — AGPL license
- `README.md`, `START_HERE.md` — original project documentation

## Version notice

The supplied README and some build files refer to earlier releases (including version 3.0). They have been preserved as provided, and should be reviewed and updated before publishing this package as a fully verified 10.3 source release. No build or runtime verification has been performed on this merged archive.

## Before publishing

Check the code, automation configuration, asset redistribution rights, copyright notices, and version references. Publishing this archive makes the included source files and assets publicly accessible.

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/README.md

# Velqora PDF 3.0
Native offline PDF editor, continuing the existing LibrePDF Pro sources. AGPL-3.0-or-later; no account, ads, subscription or web server.

## Install
Open Velqora-PDF-3.0-macOS-Intel.dmg and drag Velqora PDF.app to Applications. End users need no Python. The app is ad-hoc signed, NOT Developer ID signed or notarized. Follow macOS's normal security interface; do not disable Gatekeeper.

Target: Intel x86_64 and macOS 11+. Build script checks the minimum OS load commands and linked libraries of every Mach-O binary. Passing these static checks is not proof of Big Sur runtime compatibility. Native execution is tested on the GitHub runner OS, reported in reports/build-host.txt. No physical 2013 Mac or Big Sur test has been performed here.

## What's new in 2.6

- After OCR, the Document Text window shows recognized text from every page. Use **Copy All Text** to copy it, or select and copy part of it. The **Document** menu has both text commands for reopened PDFs as well.
- OCR results opened from password-protected PDFs keep the source password when saved.
- The installed macOS app asks once if you want Velqora to open PDFs by default. You can decline or return to **Document → Set as Default PDF App**. If macOS cannot apply the change, the app shows the equivalent Finder steps.
- Finder requests to open a PDF during startup are queued until the window is ready.

## Working features
- Own coral/graphite identity, original icons, light/dark theme, native menus, document tabs, recent documents and workspace preferences.
- Open/save/password PDFs, drag files, zoom/Ctrl-wheel/fit width, selected-page thumbnail and drag page ordering, search, bookmarks, links, properties, printing.
- Add/replace/delete/move text; double-click a text line to edit. Choose standard font, size, color and paragraph alignment. Replacement removes old characters and reconstructs the region, rather than covering the old text.
- Add/move/scale/replace/delete/rotate/export images. Shared image resources are refused to prevent editing other occurrences. Movement preserves soft-mask transparency.
- Rotate/duplicate/delete/insert/crop pages, insert another PDF, extract selected pages, split into groups.
- Six built-in offline OCR languages: Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish, Turkish. Runs in a separate process with progress and cancellation. Creates a new rasterized searchable PDF at 150 dpi; save it separately.
- Highlight, underline, strikeout, notes, rectangle, circle, arrow, delete page annotations and export annotation JSON.
- Fill basic PDF fields; draw a visual signature and place as an image; edit title/author/subject/keywords; watermarks and page numbers.
- TXT/HTML/PNG/text-only DOCX export; images to PDF; AES-256 password save, retained encryption on subsequent save; actual redaction; lossless cleanup/deflation on save.
- Atomic saves, transactional rollback, bounded undo/redo, Save/Discard/Cancel on close.

## Limits
This is not complete Acrobat parity. Text replacement uses a chosen base font and does not preserve original PDF operators, embedded fonts, exact layout or text flow across paragraphs. Standard-font coverage is limited. Redaction should be inspected in a saved copy before distribution; previous originals and undo history may retain sensitive content until closed.
No certified digital signatures, PDF/A, DOCX import, precise Word layout/table conversion, automatic OCR language detection, batch interface, autosave/recovery, image crop, ink annotation or visual document comparison. Comparison is extracted text only. Radio buttons and multi-select forms have limited support. Printing rasterizes pages.
Rendering and large document mutations still run on the UI thread and may pause on complex/large files; only the selected page is rendered, capped at 6 million pixels. OCR is isolated in a child process, not a MuPDF thread. Undo snapshots can use up to ~48 MiB plus the live document (one large transient snapshot can exceed this).

## Source run
Python 3.11: `python -m venv .venv`, activate, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then `python src/main.py`.
The source ZIP already includes six tessdata_fast models (Apache-2.0) pinned to upstream commit 87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd, hashes in assets/tessdata/manifest.json.

## Build and tests
`bash scripts/build_macos.sh` on an Intel Mac with Python 3.11.9. Dependencies and hashes are pinned in requirements-macos.lock (PySide6 6.5.3 and PyMuPDF 1.24.11). The CI wrapper in the existing repository extracts the source ZIP and invokes this script on macos-15-intel.
Tests: `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python src/main.py --self-test --report report.json`.
Build verifies architecture/dependencies, runs frozen app offscreen and Cocoa tests, creates an HFS+ DMG, mounts read-only, checks app/Applications link, repeats binary audit and runs the mounted standalone application.
Authoritative results are in the accompanying build reports; do not interpret this README as proof a build passed.

# Velqora PDF 2.6

- Scroll continuously through pages. The page counter follows the visible page.

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/RESEARCH.md
========================================================================================
# Technische keuze en verificatie — 10 november 2026

Beschikbare host: Linux x86_64. Geen macOS SDK/runtime, geen echte Intel Mac, geen ingelogde gh CLI. De GitHub-koppeling herkent het account en kan bestaande repositories lezen, maar biedt hier geen repositoryaanmaak of dispatch van nieuwe workflowruns. De browser toont GitHub-sign-in. Beschikbare GitHub-connectoracties bevatten repositorybestanden en workflowresultaten, maar geen mogelijkheid om hier een macOS-host te provisionen of een nieuwe workflowrun te starten. Daarom geen macOS-binary of DMG geclaimd.

Gekozen: CPython 3.11, PySide6 6.5.3, PyMuPDF 1.24.11. Qt 6.5 ondersteunt macOS 11 en Intel. De PySide6 6.5.3-wheel is macosx_11_0_universal2. De PyMuPDF 1.24.11-wheel heeft een macosx_10_9_x86_64-tag. Tags en ondersteunde platforms zijn aanwijzingen, geen runtimebewijs; de uiteindelijke gebundelde bestanden moeten de audit en een Big Sur-test doorstaan.

Primaire bronnen:

- https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.5/supported-platforms.html
- https://pypi.org/project/PySide6/6.5.3/
- https://pypi.org/project/PyMuPDF/1.24.11/
- https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF
- https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-where-workflows-run/choose-the-runner-for-a-job
- https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/13045
- https://pyinstaller.org/en/v6.11.1/usage.html#building-macos-app-bundles

Een echte externe Intel-build is technisch mogelijk via GitHub Actions `macos-15-intel`. Dat is opgenomen als workflow; niet daadwerkelijk uitgevoerd. Runnerbeschikbaarheid kan veranderen. De compatibiliteitsaudit weigert een te hoge deployment target in afhankelijkheden, in plaats van uitsluitend Info.plist op 11.0 te zetten.

OCR is optioneel via een lokale Tesseract-subprocess. Er is nog geen compatibele, volledig meegenomen macOS-Tesseractdistributie onderzocht/gebouwd. qpdf, OCRmyPDF en Poppler zouden extra distributie- en licentiewerk vragen en zijn niet geïntegreerd.

Geen uitspraak dat alle oudere dependencyversies tegenwoordig de veiligste keuzes zijn. Versies zijn hier gekozen voor het expliciete oude besturingssysteem en moeten voor een publiek verspreide release opnieuw worden onderhouden en gecontroleerd.


Vervolg: echte macOS-wheels en het CPython 3.11.9-macos11.pkg uit de setup-python-release zijn statisch onderzocht op Linux. Rapporten met wheelhashes, onderzochte Intel-binaries en minimumtargets staan in verification/. Dit is headeronderzoek, geen uitvoering van macOS-code. De nieuwe workflow bevat een dependency-hashlock, blijvende foutlogs en read-only DMG-mountcontroles. Er is nog geen GitHub-run gestart.

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/START_HERE.md

# Velqora PDF 2.6
Native offline PDF editor, continuing the existing LibrePDF Pro sources. AGPL-3.0-or-later; no account, ads, subscription or web server.

## Install
Open Velqora-PDF-2.6-macOS-Intel.dmg and drag Velqora PDF.app to Applications. End users need no Python. The app is ad-hoc signed, NOT Developer ID signed or notarized. Follow macOS's normal security interface; do not disable Gatekeeper.

Target: Intel x86_64 and macOS 11+. Build script checks the minimum OS load commands and linked libraries of every Mach-O binary. Passing these static checks is not proof of Big Sur runtime compatibility. Native execution is tested on the GitHub runner OS, reported in reports/build-host.txt. No physical 2013 Mac or Big Sur test has been performed here.

## What's new in 2.6

- After OCR, the Document Text window shows recognized text from every page. Use **Copy All Text** to copy it, or select and copy part of it. The **Document** menu has both text commands for reopened PDFs as well.
- OCR results opened from password-protected PDFs keep the source password when saved.
- The installed macOS app asks once if you want Velqora to open PDFs by default. You can decline or return to **Document → Set as Default PDF App**. If macOS cannot apply the change, the app shows the equivalent Finder steps.
- Finder requests to open a PDF during startup are queued until the window is ready.

## Working features
- Own coral/graphite identity, original icons, light/dark theme, native menus, document tabs, recent documents and workspace preferences.
- Open/save/password PDFs, drag files, zoom/Ctrl-wheel/fit width, selected-page thumbnail and drag page ordering, search, bookmarks, links, properties, printing.
- Add/replace/delete/move text; double-click a text line to edit. Choose standard font, size, color and paragraph alignment. Replacement removes old characters and reconstructs the region, rather than covering the old text.
- Add/move/scale/replace/delete/rotate/export images. Shared image resources are refused to prevent editing other occurrences. Movement preserves soft-mask transparency.
- Rotate/duplicate/delete/insert/crop pages, insert another PDF, extract selected pages, split into groups.
- Six built-in offline OCR languages: Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish, Turkish. Runs in a separate process with progress and cancellation. Creates a new rasterized searchable PDF at 150 dpi; save it separately.
- Highlight, underline, strikeout, notes, rectangle, circle, arrow, delete page annotations and export annotation JSON.
- Fill basic PDF fields; draw a visual signature and place as an image; edit title/author/subject/keywords; watermarks and page numbers.
- TXT/HTML/PNG/text-only DOCX export; images to PDF; AES-256 password save, retained encryption on subsequent save; actual redaction; lossless cleanup/deflation on save.
- Atomic saves, transactional rollback, bounded undo/redo, Save/Discard/Cancel on close.

## Limits
This is not complete Acrobat parity. Text replacement uses a chosen base font and does not preserve original PDF operators, embedded fonts, exact layout or text flow across paragraphs. Standard-font coverage is limited. Redaction should be inspected in a saved copy before distribution; previous originals and undo history may retain sensitive content until closed.
No certified digital signatures, PDF/A, DOCX import, precise Word layout/table conversion, automatic OCR language detection, batch interface, autosave/recovery, image crop, ink annotation or visual document comparison. Comparison is extracted text only. Radio buttons and multi-select forms have limited support. Printing rasterizes pages.
Rendering and large document mutations still run on the UI thread and may pause on complex/large files; only the selected page is rendered, capped at 6 million pixels. OCR is isolated in a child process, not a MuPDF thread. Undo snapshots can use up to ~48 MiB plus the live document (one large transient snapshot can exceed this).

## Source run
Python 3.11: `python -m venv .venv`, activate, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then `python src/main.py`.
The source ZIP already includes six tessdata_fast models (Apache-2.6) pinned to upstream commit 87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd, hashes in assets/tessdata/manifest.json.

## Build and tests
`bash scripts/build_macos.sh` on an Intel Mac with Python 3.11.9. Dependencies and hashes are pinned in requirements-macos.lock (PySide6 6.5.3 and PyMuPDF 1.24.11). The CI wrapper in the existing repository extracts the source ZIP and invokes this script on macos-15-intel.
Tests: `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python src/main.py --self-test --report report.json`.
Build verifies architecture/dependencies, runs frozen app offscreen and Cocoa tests, creates an HFS+ DMG, mounts read-only, checks app/Applications link, repeats binary audit and runs the mounted standalone application.
Authoritative results are in the accompanying build reports; do not interpret this README as proof a build passed.

# Velqora PDF 2.3 verification

All 16 unit tests and 16 integrated app checks passed on Linux x86_64 with Python 3.12.14, Qt 6.6.3 and PyMuPDF 1.24.11. The new checks cover cross-page search, persistent highlighting, ordered page extraction, encryption retention and checkbox save/reopen. Manual smoke checks also verified dropdown values and mixed English–Dutch OCR.

The page-range checks cover undo, password retention when splitting, refusal to overwrite outputs, and cleanup after a simulated write failure.

The macOS build runs the same tests with the pinned native dependencies. See the build reports for the runner version and mounted DMG verification. macOS Big Sur runtime verification is pending.

The Linux app check copied recognized text from two pages in order. The Launch Services lookup is exercised by the frozen macOS self-test. Changing the system default is an interactive macOS action.

De editor gebruikt geen qpdf, Poppler, OCRmyPDF of pypdf. Voeg geen ongebruikte afhankelijkheden toe alleen omdat ze in het oorspronkelijke wensenpakket stonden.

De macOS-build neemt licentieteksten en package metadata mee via PyInstaller. De bron-ZIP bevat de eigen AGPL-licentie en dependencyversies; upstream-broncode is via bovenstaande links beschikbaar en niet volledig in dit kleine projectarchief opgenomen. Bij een daadwerkelijke binaryrelease moeten notices en corresponderende dependencybronnen blijvend beschikbaar worden gesteld. LGPL-bibliotheken blijven dynamisch; geen restrictie op vervanging of reverse engineering voor debugging van wijzigingen toevoegen.

Velqora 2.0 bundles tessdata_fast language data nld/eng/deu/fra/spa/tur under Apache-2.0; license in assets/tessdata/LICENSE. Pinned source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/tree/87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd . MuPDF's integrated Tesseract is used instead of a required external executable. Original icons drawn in workspace.py and make_icon.py.

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/Velqora-Windows.spec
========================================================================================
# Native Windows x64 build. Keep the executable with its _internal folder.
from pathlib import Path
from PyInstaller.utils.hooks import copy_metadata

root = Path(SPECPATH)
notices = []
for package in ('PyMuPDF', 'PySide6', 'PySide6-Essentials', 'PySide6-Addons', 'shiboken6', 'Pillow'):
    notices.extend(copy_metadata(package))

analysis = Analysis(
    [str(root / 'src/main.py')],
    pathex=[str(root / 'src')],
    datas=[(str(root / 'assets'), 'assets')] + [
        (str(root / name), '.') for name in ('LICENSE', 'THIRD_PARTY.md', 'WINDOWS.md')
    ] + notices,
    hiddenimports=['fitz', 'pymupdf'],
    excludes=['PySide6.QtWebEngineCore', 'PySide6.QtWebEngineWidgets', 'numpy', 'tkinter'],
)
archive = PYZ(analysis.pure)
executable = EXE(
    archive, analysis.scripts, [], exclude_binaries=True,
    name='Velqora PDF', console=False, icon=str(root / 'assets/icon.png'),
)
distribution = COLLECT(executable, analysis.binaries, analysis.datas, name='Velqora PDF')

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/linux-build/README.md
========================================================================================
# Velqora PDF 10.3 on Linux

For 64-bit Intel and AMD Linux. Give the downloaded AppImage execute permission and run it. On systems without FUSE, pass `--appimage-extract-and-run`.

The package contains Python and Qt, the six offline OCR models and the 200 font families from the existing Velqora Linux package. It uses the system's Linux desktop libraries. The bundled ELF objects require glibc symbols through version 2.28. A full native desktop session was not tested on Ubuntu or Manjaro.

## Rebuild from this archive

Use CPython 3.12 x86_64 on Linux with a glibc 2.28-compatible build of Python. From the archive root:

```sh
python3.12 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -r linux-build/requirements-linux.txt
.venv/bin/pyinstaller --noconfirm --distpath linux-build/dist --workpath linux-build/work linux-build/Velqora-Linux.spec
```

Copy `libxcb-cursor.so.0` (dereferencing any symlink) into `linux-build/dist/velqora-pdf/_internal/`, along with the library's copyright notice. The release used Debian's `libxcb-cursor0_0.1.4-1_amd64.deb`. Its [source](https://sources.debian.org/src/xcb-util-cursor/0.1.4-1/) and [binary package](https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/x/xcb-util-cursor/libxcb-cursor0_0.1.4-1_amd64.deb) are available from Debian.

Then pass the official [x86_64 AppImage Type 2 runtime](https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/tree/fedfad5) and a `mksquashfs` executable with Zstd support to:

```sh
linux-build/package-appimage.sh linux-build/dist/velqora-pdf ./runtime-x86_64 "$(command -v mksquashfs)" Velqora-PDF-10.3-Linux-x86_64.AppImage
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ./Velqora-PDF-10.3-Linux-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run --self-test --report ./linux-test.json
```

The release's test report is included. Velqora source and font notices are under `project/`.

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/linux-build/Velqora-Linux.spec
========================================================================================
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(SPECPATH).parent / 'project'
app = Analysis(
    [str(root / 'src/main.py')],
    pathex=[str(root / 'src')],
    datas=[(str(root / 'assets'), 'assets'),
           *[(str(root / name), '.') for name in ('README.md', 'LICENSE', 'THIRD_PARTY.md')]],
    hiddenimports=['fitz', 'pymupdf', 'PySide6.QtSvg'],
    excludes=['PySide6.QtWebEngineCore', 'PySide6.QtWebEngineWidgets', 'numpy', 'tkinter'],
)
app.exclude_system_libraries()
archive = PYZ(app.pure)
program = EXE(archive, app.scripts, [], exclude_binaries=True, name='velqora-pdf', console=True)
bundle = COLLECT(program, app.binaries, app.datas, name='velqora-pdf')

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/linux-build/package-appimage.sh
========================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ $# != 4 ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 FROZEN_APP APPIMAGE_RUNTIME MKSQUASHFS OUTPUT.AppImage" >&2
    exit 2
fi
frozen=$(realpath "$1")
runtime=$(realpath "$2")
squash=$(realpath "$3")
output=$(realpath -m "$4")
script_dir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
stage=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$stage/AppDir/usr/bin"
cp -a "$frozen/." "$stage/AppDir/usr/bin/"
cp "$script_dir/AppRun" "$script_dir/org.velqora.pdf.desktop" "$stage/AppDir/"
cp "$frozen/_internal/assets/icon.png" "$stage/AppDir/org.velqora.pdf.png"
ln -s org.velqora.pdf.png "$stage/AppDir/.DirIcon"
"$squash" "$stage/AppDir" "$stage/filesystem.squashfs" -comp zstd -Xcompression-level 17 -b 1048576 -noappend -no-xattrs -all-root -processors 4 -no-progress
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$output")"
cat "$runtime" "$stage/filesystem.squashfs" > "$output"
chmod 755 "$output"

"""Static audit of final .app, usable on macOS or Linux. Does not prove Big Sur execution."""
import argparse,json,plistlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from macho import read_macho,MAGICS

def audit(app, architecture='x86_64'):
    app=Path(app).resolve();errors=[];binaries=[]
    info_path=app/'Contents/Info.plist'
    if not info_path.exists():raise ValueError('Missing Info.plist')
    info=plistlib.loads(info_path.read_bytes())
    if info.get('LSMinimumSystemVersion')!='11.0':errors.append('Info.plist minimum must be 11.0')
    executable=app/'Contents/MacOS'/info.get('CFBundleExecutable','')
    if not executable.is_file():errors.append('Missing application executable')
    if not (app/'Contents/Resources'/info.get('CFBundleIconFile','icon.icns')).is_file():errors.append('Missing application icon')
    records={}
    for path in app.rglob('*'):
        if path.is_symlink():
            if not path.exists():errors.append(f'Broken symlink: {path.relative_to(app)}')
            elif not path.resolve().is_relative_to(app):errors.append(f'External symlink: {path.relative_to(app)}')
            continue
        if not path.is_file():continue
        with path.open('rb') as f:
            if f.read(4) not in MAGICS:continue
        slices=read_macho(path.read_bytes());native=next((s for s in slices if s['arch']==architecture),None)
        if not native:errors.append(f'No {architecture} slice: {path.relative_to(app)}');continue
        if native['minimum'] is None:errors.append(f'Missing deployment target: {path.relative_to(app)}')
        elif native['minimum']>[11,0,0] or native['platform']!=1:errors.append(f'Incompatible target {native["minimum"]}: {path.relative_to(app)}')
        records[path.resolve()]=native
    main=records.get(executable.resolve(),{})
    def expand(value,loader):
        return Path(value.replace('@loader_path',str(loader.parent)).replace('@executable_path',str(executable.parent)))
    for path,native in records.items():
        dependencies=[]
        for dep in native['dependencies']:
            name=dep['name'];target=None
            if name.startswith(('/System/Library/','/usr/lib/')):
                dependencies.append(dict(dep,resolution='macOS system library'));continue
            if name.startswith('@rpath/'):
                for rp in native['rpaths']:
                    candidate=expand(rp,path)/name[len('@rpath/'):]
                    if candidate.exists():target=candidate.resolve();break
                if target is None:
                    for rp in main.get('rpaths',[]):
                        candidate=expand(rp,executable)/name[len('@rpath/'):]
                        if candidate.exists():target=candidate.resolve();break
            elif name.startswith(('@loader_path/','@executable_path/')):target=expand(name,path).resolve()
            elif name.startswith('/'):target=Path(name).resolve()
            if target is None or not target.exists() or not target.is_relative_to(app):
                errors.append(f'Unresolved/external dependency {name}: {path.relative_to(app)}')
                resolution='UNRESOLVED'
            else:resolution=str(target.relative_to(app))
            dependencies.append(dict(dep,resolution=resolution))
        binaries.append({'path':str(path.relative_to(app)),'minimum':native['minimum'],'rpaths':native['rpaths'],'dependencies':dependencies})
    if not main:errors.append(f'Main executable has no valid {architecture} Mach-O slice')
    if not binaries:errors.append('No Mach-O binaries found')
    return {'scope':'Static bundle audit only; Big Sur runtime test still required','architecture':architecture,'minimum_system_version':info.get('LSMinimumSystemVersion'),'binaries':binaries,'errors':errors}

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('app')
    parser.add_argument('--architecture', choices=['x86_64','arm64'], default='x86_64')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:report=audit(args.app,args.architecture)
    except Exception as ex:report={'errors':[str(ex)]}
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2));sys.exit(bool(report['errors']))

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
mkdir -p dist/reports
# Keep output for failed as well as successful builds. pipefail propagates errors.
exec > >(tee -a dist/reports/build.log) 2>&1
[[ "$(uname -s)" == Darwin ]] || { echo 'Requires a macOS build host'; exit 1; }
architecture="$(uname -m)"
case "$architecture" in
  x86_64) edition=Intel ;;
  arm64) edition=AppleSilicon ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $architecture"; exit 1 ;;
esac
dmg="Velqora-PDF-10.3-macOS-${edition}.dmg"
export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0
python3.11 -c 'import platform,sys; assert sys.version_info[:2]==(3,11) and platform.machine()==sys.argv[1]' "$architecture"
python3.11 -m venv .venv-build
source .venv-build/bin/activate
if [[ "$architecture" == x86_64 ]]; then
  python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r requirements-macos.lock
else
  python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: -r requirements-macos-arm64.txt
fi
python -m pip check
python -m pip freeze > dist/reports/installed-dependencies.txt
python -m pip inspect > dist/reports/installed-dependencies.json
python -c 'import platform,sys; print(sys.version); print(platform.platform())' > dist/reports/build-host.txt
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python tests/smoke_gui.py
python scripts/make_icon.py
python -m PyInstaller --clean --noconfirm LibrePDF.spec
cp build/LibrePDF/warn-LibrePDF.txt dist/reports/pyinstaller-warnings.txt
python scripts/audit_macos.py 'dist/Velqora PDF.app' --architecture "$architecture" > dist/reports/bundle-audit.json
python scripts/run_app_test.py 'dist/Velqora PDF.app' dist/reports/app-offscreen-selftest.json --platform offscreen
python scripts/run_app_test.py 'dist/Velqora PDF.app' dist/reports/app-cocoa-selftest.json --platform cocoa
codesign --display --verbose=4 'dist/Velqora PDF.app' > dist/reports/signature.txt 2>&1
codesign --verify --deep --strict 'dist/Velqora PDF.app'
# A temporary staging tree makes reruns safe and keeps stale files out of the DMG.
staging_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/librepdf-stage.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$staging_dir"' EXIT
/usr/bin/ditto 'dist/Velqora PDF.app' "$staging_dir/Velqora PDF.app"
ln -s /Applications "$staging_dir/Applications"
hdiutil create -volname 'Velqora PDF' -srcfolder "$staging_dir" -ov -fs HFS+ -format UDZO "dist/$dmg"
python scripts/verify_dmg.py "dist/$dmg"
(cd dist && shasum -a 256 "$dmg" > SHA256SUMS)
echo 'Build and mounted-DMG checks passed on this build host. Big Sur runtime is not verified.'

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/scripts/check_wheels.py

"""Static preflight of macOS wheels; does NOT prove Big Sur execution."""
import json,sys,zipfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from macho import read_macho,MAGICS

def inspect(directory):
    reports=[];errors=[]
    for wheel in sorted(Path(directory).glob('*.whl')):
        binaries=[]
        with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z:
            for info in z.infolist():
                if info.is_dir() or info.file_size<4:continue
                with z.open(info) as f:
                    if f.read(4) not in MAGICS:continue
                slices=read_macho(z.read(info))
                intel=next((s for s in slices if s['arch']=='x86_64'),None)
                if not intel:errors.append(f'{wheel.name}:{info.filename}: no Intel slice')
                else:
                    binaries.append({'path':info.filename,'minimum':intel['minimum'],'platform':intel['platform']})
                    if intel['minimum'] is None or intel['minimum']>[11,0,0] or intel['platform']!=1:
                        errors.append(f'{wheel.name}:{info.filename}: incompatible target {intel["minimum"]}')
        reports.append({'wheel':wheel.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'intel_binaries':binaries})
    if not reports:errors.append('No wheels found')
    return {'scope':'Static headers only; not a runtime test, not a final app audit','wheels':reports,'errors':errors}

if __name__=='__main__':
    report=inspect(sys.argv[1]);print(json.dumps(report,indent=2));sys.exit(bool(report['errors']))

cairo carlito carroisgothic changa courgette delagothicone didactgothic dynapuff electrolize

martelsans mate matesc mclaren
"""

def fetch(url):
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Velqora-PDF-build'}
    token = os.environ.get('VELQORA_FONT_TOKEN')
    if token and url.startswith('https://api.github.com/'):
        headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token
    request = Request(url, headers=headers)
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=40) as response:
                return response.read()
        except OSError:
            if attempt == 3:
                raise
            time.sleep(attempt + 1)

def tree(ref, recursive=False):
    query = '?recursive=1' if recursive else ''
    data = json.loads(fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/google/fonts/git/trees/' + ref + query))
    if data.get('truncated'):
        raise RuntimeError('The upstream font tree was truncated.')
    return data

def main():
    commit = json.loads(fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/google/fonts/commits/main'))['sha']
    root = tree(commit)
    ofl = next(entry['sha'] for entry in root['tree'] if entry['path'] == 'ofl')
    families = {}
    for entry in tree(ofl, recursive=True)['tree']:
        family, separator, path = entry['path'].partition('/')
        if separator and '/' not in path:
            families.setdefault(family, []).append(path)

    choices = []
    for name in dict.fromkeys(FAMILIES.split() + sorted(families)):
        files = families.get(name, [])
        if 'OFL.txt' not in files or 'METADATA.pb' not in files:
            continue
        fonts = [file for file in files if file.endswith('.ttf') and 'italic' not in file.lower()]
        if fonts:
            filename = min(fonts, key=lambda file: ('-Regular.ttf' not in file, '[' not in file, len(file)))
            choices.append((name, filename))
        if len(choices) == 200:
            break
    if len(choices) != 200:
        raise RuntimeError('Could not resolve 200 OFL families.')

    dest = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'assets/fonts'
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    def download(item):
        slug, filename = item
        base = f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/{commit}/ofl/{slug}/'
        folder = dest / slug
        folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for name in (filename, 'OFL.txt', 'METADATA.pb'):
            (folder / name).write_bytes(fetch(base + quote(name)))
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as pool:
        list(pool.map(download, choices))
    (dest / 'source.txt').write_text(f'https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/{commit}/ofl\n')
    print(f'Bundled {len(choices)} OFL font families at {commit}.', flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/scripts/macho.py
========================================================================================
"""Read Mach-O metadata without executing it; usable on Linux for preflight.
Only binary headers/load commands are inspected, never patched.
"""
import struct

X86_64=0x01000007
ARM64=0x0100000C
MAGICS=(b'\xce\xfa\xed\xfe',b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe',b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xce',b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf',b'\xca\xfe\xba\xbe',b'\xbe\xba\xfe\xca',b'\xca\xfe\xba\xbf',b'\xbf\xba\xfe\xca')

def version(n):return [n>>16,(n>>8)&255,n&255]

def read_macho(data):
    """Return one dict per slice, or [] for a non-Mach-O file."""
    magic=data[:4]
    if magic not in MAGICS:return []
    if magic in MAGICS[4:]:
        endian='>' if magic in (MAGICS[4],MAGICS[6]) else '<'
        is64=magic in MAGICS[6:]
        count=struct.unpack_from(endian+'I',data,4)[0]
        if count>128:raise ValueError('Invalid fat architecture count')
        slices=[]
        for n in range(count):
            at=8+n*(32 if is64 else 20)
            fields=struct.unpack_from(endian+('IIQQII' if is64 else 'IIIII'),data,at)
            offset,size=fields[2:4]
            if offset+size>len(data):raise ValueError('Truncated fat binary')
            slices.extend(read_macho(data[offset:offset+size]))
        return slices
    endian='<' if magic in MAGICS[:2] else '>'
    is64=magic in (MAGICS[1],MAGICS[3])
    cpu,subcpu,kind,ncmds,sizeofcmds=struct.unpack_from(endian+'IIIII',data,4)
    at=32 if is64 else 28
    if at+sizeofcmds>len(data):raise ValueError('Truncated Mach-O load commands')
    result={'cpu':cpu,'arch':{X86_64:'x86_64',ARM64:'arm64'}.get(cpu,hex(cpu)), 'filetype':kind,'minimum':None,'platform':None,'dependencies':[],'rpaths':[]}
    for _ in range(ncmds):
        cmd,size=struct.unpack_from(endian+'II',data,at)
        if size<8 or at+size>len(data):raise ValueError('Invalid Mach-O command size')
        if cmd==0x32:
            platform,minos=struct.unpack_from(endian+'II',data,at+8)
            result.update(minimum=version(minos),platform=platform)
        elif cmd==0x24:
            result.update(minimum=version(struct.unpack_from(endian+'I',data,at+8)[0]),platform=1)
        elif cmd in (0xc,0x80000018,0x8000001f,0x80000023,0x20):
            offset=struct.unpack_from(endian+'I',data,at+8)[0]
            name=data[at+offset:at+size].split(b'\0',1)[0].decode('utf-8')
            result['dependencies'].append({'name':name,'weak':cmd==0x80000018})
        elif cmd==0x8000001c:
            offset=struct.unpack_from(endian+'I',data,at+8)[0]
            result['rpaths'].append(data[at+offset:at+size].split(b'\0',1)[0].decode('utf-8'))
        at+=size
    return [result]

"""Launch only the bundled executable, without Python/Qt/DYLD environment hints."""
import argparse,json,os,platform,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('app');parser.add_argument('report');parser.add_argument('--platform',choices=['offscreen','cocoa'],default='cocoa');args=parser.parse_args()
    app=Path(args.app).resolve();report=Path(args.report).resolve();report.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('PYTHON','QT_','QML','DYLD_','VIRTUAL_ENV','CONDA_'))}
    env['PATH']='/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'
    env['QT_QPA_PLATFORM']=args.platform
    executable=app/'Contents/MacOS/Velqora PDF'
    try:
        process=subprocess.run([str(executable),'--self-test','--report',str(report)],env=env,cwd='/tmp',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
        report.with_suffix('.stdout.log').write_text(process.stdout or '')
        report.with_suffix('.stderr.log').write_text(process.stderr or '')
        if process.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'Bundled app exited {process.returncode}: {process.stderr[-3000:]}')
        result=json.loads(report.read_text())
        if result.get('status')!='passed' or result.get('frozen') is not True or result.get('machine')!=platform.machine():
            raise RuntimeError(f'Invalid self-test result: {result}')
        print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
    except Exception as ex:
        print(str(ex),file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(1)

"""Mount read-only; verify app, Applications link and bundled startup; always detach."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,platform,plistlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
from audit_macos import audit

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('dmg');parser.add_argument('--reports',default='dist/reports');args=parser.parse_args()
    dmg=Path(args.dmg).resolve();reports=Path(args.reports).resolve();reports.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    result={'status':'failed','dmg':dmg.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(dmg.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'big_sur_runtime_verified':False}
    mounted=False
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='librepdf-dmg-') as temp:
        mount=Path(temp)/'volume';mount.mkdir()
        try:
            subprocess.run(['hdiutil','verify',str(dmg)],check=True)
            attach=subprocess.run(['hdiutil','attach','-readonly','-nobrowse','-plist','-mountpoint',str(mount),str(dmg)],check=True,capture_output=True)
            mounted=True
            info=plistlib.loads(attach.stdout)
            result['volume_attached']=any(x.get('mount-point') and Path(x['mount-point']).resolve()==mount.resolve() for x in info.get('system-entities',[]))
            if not result['volume_attached']:raise RuntimeError('Unexpected mount point')
            app=mount/'Velqora PDF.app';shortcut=mount/'Applications'
            if not app.is_dir() or not shortcut.is_symlink() or os.readlink(shortcut)!='/Applications':raise RuntimeError('Missing .app or incorrect Applications shortcut')
            contents=sorted(p.name for p in mount.iterdir());result['root_contents']=contents
            bundle=audit(app,platform.machine());(reports/'dmg-bundle-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(bundle,indent=2))
            if bundle['errors']:raise RuntimeError('Mounted bundle failed dependency/architecture audit')
            subprocess.run(['codesign','--verify','--deep','--strict',str(app)],check=True)
            subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(Path(__file__).with_name('run_app_test.py')),str(app),str(reports/'dmg-app-selftest.json'),'--platform','cocoa'],check=True)
            result['status']='passed'
        except Exception as ex:
            result['error']=str(ex);raise
        finally:
            if mounted:
                for attempt in range(5):
                    detached = subprocess.run(['hdiutil', 'detach', str(mount)], capture_output=True)
                    if detached.returncode == 0:
                        break
                    time.sleep(1)
                else:
                    subprocess.run(['hdiutil', 'detach', '-force', str(mount)], check=True)
            (reports/'dmg-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Verify the packaged executable and all included PE binaries."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct


def architecture(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        if stream.read(2) != b'MZ':
            raise ValueError(f'{path}: missing DOS signature')
        stream.seek(0x3C)
        offset = struct.unpack('<I', stream.read(4))[0]
        stream.seek(offset)
        if stream.read(4) != b'PE\0\0':
            raise ValueError(f'{path}: missing PE signature')
        return struct.unpack('<H', stream.read(2))[0]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('folder', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('report', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.folder
    exe = root / 'Velqora PDF.exe'
    if not exe.is_file() or not list(root.rglob('qwindows.dll')):
        raise SystemExit('The executable or Windows Qt plugin is missing.')
    binaries = sorted(
        path for path in root.rglob('*')
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in ('.exe', '.dll', '.pyd')
    )
    for path in binaries:
        if architecture(path) != 0x8664:
            raise SystemExit(f'{path} is not AMD64.')
    args.report.write_text(json.dumps({
        'status': 'passed',
        'architecture': 'AMD64',
        'binaries': [path.relative_to(root).as_posix() for path in binaries],
    }, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""OCR runs as a child process; MuPDF is never invoked in a GUI worker thread."""
import sys,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from PySide6.QtCore import QThread,Signal

class OCRWorker(QThread):
    completed=Signal(bytes)
    failed=Signal(str)
    progress=Signal(int)
    def __init__(self,data,language,preserve_pages=False,repeat=False,page_index=None):
        super().__init__();self.data=data;self.language=language;self.preserve_pages=preserve_pages;self.repeat=repeat;self.page_index=page_index
    def run(self):
        try:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='velqora-ocr-') as temp:
                root=Path(temp);(root/'input.pdf').write_bytes(self.data);(root/'request.json').write_text(json.dumps({'language':self.language,'preserve_pages':self.preserve_pages,'repeat':self.repeat,'page_index':self.page_index}));self.data=b''
                command=[sys.executable]
                if not getattr(sys,'frozen',False):command.append(str(Path(__file__).with_name('main.py')))
                command+=['--velqora-worker',temp]
                with (root/'stderr.log').open('w') as log:
                    creation_flags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if sys.platform == 'win32' else 0
                    process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=log,creationflags=creation_flags);previous=0
                    while process.poll() is None:
                        if self.isInterruptionRequested():
                            process.terminate()
                            try:
                                process.wait(timeout=.7)
                            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                                process.kill()
                                process.wait()
                            return
                        if (root/'progress').exists():
                            lines=(root/'progress').read_text().splitlines()
                            if len(lines)>previous and lines[-1].isdigit():self.progress.emit(int(lines[-1]));previous=len(lines)
                        self.msleep(100)
                    if process.returncode:raise RuntimeError((root/'error.txt').read_text() if (root/'error.txt').exists() else (root/'stderr.log').read_text()[-2000:])
                if not self.isInterruptionRequested():
                    self.completed.emit((root/'output.pdf').read_bytes())
        except Exception as ex:self.failed.emit(str(ex))

"""Minimal standards-based text DOCX export. No promise of layout preservation."""
from zipfile import ZipFile,ZIP_DEFLATED
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

def export_docx(pdf,path):
    body=[]
    for n,page in enumerate(pdf):
        if n:body.append('<w:p><w:r><w:br w:type="page"/></w:r></w:p>')
        for line in page.get_text().splitlines():body.append('<w:p><w:r><w:t xml:space="preserve">'+escape(line)+'</w:t></w:r></w:p>')
    with ZipFile(path,'w',ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        z.writestr('[Content_Types].xml','<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml"/></Types>')
        z.writestr('_rels/.rels','<?xml version="1.0"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="word/document.xml"/></Relationships>')
        z.writestr('word/document.xml','<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body>'+''.join(body)+'<w:sectPr/></w:body></w:document>')

"""Offline PDF operations. AGPL-3.0-or-later."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
import fitz

class Document:
    def __init__(self, path=None, password=None):
        self.pdf = fitz.open(path) if path else fitz.open()
        if self.pdf.needs_pass and not self.pdf.authenticate(password or ''):
            self.pdf.close()
            raise ValueError('The password is missing or incorrect.')
        if not path:
            self.pdf.new_page()
        self.password=password
        self.path = path
        self.undo_stack, self.redo_stack = [], []
        self.dirty = False

    def document_text(self):
        pages = (page.get_text('text', sort=True).strip() for page in self.pdf)
        return '\n\n'.join(text for text in pages if text)

    def snapshot(self):
        return self.pdf.tobytes(garbage=0)

    def change(self, operation):
        before = self.snapshot()
        try:
            operation(self.pdf)
            # Reopen after edits to invalidate MuPDF page/annotation caches.
            updated=self.pdf.tobytes(garbage=1)
            self.pdf.close()
            self.pdf=fitz.open(stream=updated,filetype="pdf")
        except Exception:
            self.pdf.close()
            self.pdf = fitz.open(stream=before, filetype='pdf')
            raise
        self.record_change(before)

    def record_change(self, before):
        # Bound undo by both count and byte size for low-memory machines.
        self.undo_stack.append(before)
        while len(self.undo_stack)>10 or sum(map(len,self.undo_stack))>48*1024*1024:
            self.undo_stack.pop(0)
        self.redo_stack.clear()
        self.dirty = True

    def undo(self, redo=False):
        source, target = (self.redo_stack,self.undo_stack) if redo else (self.undo_stack,self.redo_stack)
        if source:
            target.append(self.snapshot())
            self.pdf.close()
            self.pdf = fitz.open(stream=source.pop(), filetype='pdf')
            self.dirty=True

    def save(self, path, password=None):
        password = password or self.password
        # Windows can lock the source until MuPDF closes its file handle.
        source = self.pdf.name
        if os.name == 'nt' and source and os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(source)) == os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(path)):
            detached = fitz.open(stream=self.snapshot(), filetype='pdf')
            self.pdf.close()
            self.pdf = detached
        self.write_pdf(self.pdf, path, password)
        self.password = password
        self.path = path
        self.dirty = False

    @staticmethod
    def write_pdf(pdf, path, password=None):
        options = dict(garbage=4, deflate=True)
        if password:
            options.update(encryption=fitz.PDF_ENCRYPT_AES_256, owner_pw=password, user_pw=password)
        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pdf',dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)))
        os.close(fd)
        try:
            pdf.save(tmp, **options)
            os.replace(tmp,path)
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)

    def add_text(self, page, rect, text, size=12, color=(0,0,0), font='helv', align=0):
        def op(pdf):
            if pdf[page].insert_textbox(fitz.Rect(rect),text,fontsize=size,fontname=font,color=color,align=align)<0:
                raise ValueError('The text does not fit. Enlarge the box or use a smaller font.')
        self.change(op)

    def replace_text(self, page, rect, text, size=12, color=(0,0,0), font='helv', align=0):
        # Actually remove old characters; keep overlapping images and line art.
        def op(pdf):
            p=pdf[page]
            p.add_redact_annot(rect,fill=False)
            p.apply_redactions(images=0,graphics=0)
            if text and p.insert_textbox(rect,text,fontsize=size,fontname=font,color=color,align=align)<0:
                raise ValueError('The replacement text does not fit. The original text was restored.')
        self.change(op)

    @staticmethod
    def original_font(page, name):
        def normalize(value):
            return ''.join(ch for ch in value.split('+')[-1].lower() if ch.isalnum())

        for xref, _, _, base, _, *_ in page.get_fonts(full=True):
            if normalize(base) == normalize(name):
                data = page.parent.extract_font(xref)[3]
                if data:
                    return data
        return None

    def edit_line(self, index, original, origin, text, size, font, color, original_name=None, font_data=None):
        page = self.pdf[index]
        embedded = self.original_font(page, original_name) if original_name and text else font_data
        if text and original_name and not embedded:
            base_name = fitz.Font(font).name
            if original_name.replace(' ', '').lower() != base_name.replace(' ', '').lower():
                raise ValueError(f'The font {original_name} is unavailable. Choose another font and apply again.')
        face = (fitz.Font(fontbuffer=embedded) if embedded else fitz.Font(font)) if text else None
        if face and any(not face.has_glyph(ord(char), fallback=False) for char in set(text)):
            raise ValueError('This font is missing a character. Choose another font and apply again.')
        if face and not embedded:
            try:
                text.encode('cp1252')
            except UnicodeEncodeError:
                embedded = face.buffer
        if face and face.text_length(text, fontsize=size) > page.cropbox.width - origin.x:
            raise ValueError('Text is too long for this line. Shorten it and press Enter.')

        def change(pdf):
            page = pdf[index]
            if original is not None:
                page.add_redact_annot(original, fill=False)
                page.apply_redactions(images=0, graphics=0)
            if text:
                if embedded:
                    from hashlib import sha256
                    font_name = 'VQ' + sha256(embedded).hexdigest()[:16]
                    page.insert_font(fontname=font_name, fontbuffer=embedded)
                else:
                    font_name = font
                if page.insert_text(origin, text, fontsize=size, fontname=font_name, color=color) < 1:
                    raise ValueError('Text does not fit at this position.')

        self.change(change)

    @staticmethod
    def fit_text_box(page, point, text, size, font, font_data):
        bounds = page.rect * page.derotation_matrix
        width = min(320, bounds.width - 12)
        face = fitz.Font(fontbuffer=font_data) if font_data else fitz.Font(font)
        if width <= size:
            raise ValueError('The page is too narrow for this font size.')
        lines = []
        for paragraph in text.split('\n'):
            remaining = paragraph.rstrip()
            while face.text_length(remaining, fontsize=size) > width - 12:
                lengths = face.char_lengths(remaining, fontsize=size)
                consumed = 0
                for count, advance in enumerate(lengths):
                    consumed += advance
                    if consumed > width - 12:
                        break
                cut = max(1, count)
                space = remaining.rfind(' ', 0, cut + 1)
                cut = space if space > 0 else cut
                lines.append(remaining[:cut].rstrip())
                remaining = remaining[cut:].lstrip()
            lines.append(remaining)
        height = max(44, size * (len(lines) + 1) * 1.45 + 8)
        if height > bounds.height - 12:
            raise ValueError('This text exceeds the page height. Reduce the font size or use multiple boxes.')
        x = min(max(point.x, bounds.x0 + 6), bounds.x1 - width - 6)
        y = min(max(point.y, bounds.y0 + 6), bounds.y1 - height - 6)
        return fitz.Rect(x, y, x + width, y + height), '\n'.join(lines)

    def add_text_box(self, index, target, text, size, color, font, align, font_data=None):
        def insert(pdf):
            page = pdf[index]
            if not font_data:
                if any(fitz.get_text_length(line, fontname=font, fontsize=size) > target.width - 6
                       for line in text.splitlines()):
                    raise ValueError('Add a line break so the text fits inside the box.')
                item = page.add_freetext_annot(target, text, fontsize=size, fontname=font,
                                               text_color=color, align=min(align, 2))
                item.set_info(title='Velqora PDF', subject='Velqora Text Box')
                item.update()
                return
            face = fitz.Font(fontbuffer=font_data)
            if any(not face.has_glyph(ord(char), fallback=False) for char in set(text) - {'\n'}):
                raise ValueError('The selected font does not contain one or more characters.')
            with fitz.open() as appearance:
                drawing = appearance.new_page(width=target.width, height=target.height)
                drawing.insert_font(fontname='VelqoraBox', fontbuffer=font_data)
                inset = drawing.rect + (3, 2, -3, -2)
                if drawing.insert_textbox(inset, text, fontname='VelqoraBox', fontsize=size,
                                          color=color, align=align) < 0:
                    raise ValueError('The text does not fit. Try a smaller size or move the box away from the page edge.')
                # Import a reusable vector Form, then remove its temporary host page.
                host = pdf.new_page(width=target.width, height=target.height)
                form = host.show_pdf_page(host.rect, appearance, 0)
                pdf.delete_page(-1)
            page = pdf[index]
            item = page.add_freetext_annot(target, text, fontsize=size, text_color=color)
            item.set_info(title='Velqora PDF', subject='Velqora Text Box')
            item.update()
            pdf.xref_set_key(item.xref, 'AP', f'<< /N {form} 0 R >>')
            pdf.xref_set_key(item.xref, 'VelqoraFontAppearance', 'true')

        self.change(insert)

    def move_overlay(self, index, xref, dx, dy):
        def move(pdf):
            page = pdf[index]
            item = page.load_annot(xref)
            old = item.rect
            bounds = page.rect * page.derotation_matrix
            dx_clamped = min(max(dx, bounds.x0 - old.x0), bounds.x1 - old.x1)
            dy_clamped = min(max(dy, bounds.y0 - old.y0), bounds.y1 - old.y1)
            if item.info['subject'] == 'Velqora Signature':
                strokes = [[(x + dx_clamped, y + dy_clamped) for x, y in stroke]
                           for stroke in item.vertices]
                updated = page.add_ink_annot(strokes)
                updated.set_info(title='Velqora PDF', subject='Velqora Signature')
                updated.set_colors(stroke=(.08, .13, .22))
                updated.set_border(width=1.5)
                updated.update()
                page.delete_annot(item)
            else:
                item.set_rect(old + (dx_clamped, dy_clamped, dx_clamped, dy_clamped))
                if pdf.xref_get_key(item.xref, 'VelqoraFontAppearance') != ('bool', 'true'):
                    item.update()

        self.change(move)

    def image(self,page,rect,path):
        self.change(lambda pdf: pdf[page].insert_image(rect,filename=path))

    def move_image(self,page,info,rect):
        def op(pdf):
            p=pdf[page]
            # Removing an xref affects all its occurrences: refuse ambiguous cases.
            if sum(len(pg.get_image_rects(info['xref'])) for pg in pdf)!=1:
                raise ValueError('This image appears more than once. Moving it would affect other copies.')
            data=self.image_bytes(pdf,info['xref'])
            p.delete_image(info['xref'])
            p.insert_image(rect,stream=data)
        self.change(op)

    def redact(self,page,rect):
        def op(pdf):
            p=pdf[page]; p.add_redact_annot(rect,fill=(0,0,0)); p.apply_redactions(images=2,graphics=1)
        self.change(op)

    def edit_image(self,page,info,path=None,remove=False,angle=0):
        def op(pdf):
            p=pdf[page]; xref=info['xref']
            if sum(len(pg.get_image_rects(xref)) for pg in pdf)!=1:
                raise ValueError('This image appears more than once. Editing it would affect other copies.')
            if remove:p.delete_image(xref)
            elif path:p.replace_image(xref,filename=path)
            else:
                from PIL import Image
                import io
                original=self.image_bytes(pdf,xref)
                image=Image.open(io.BytesIO(original)).rotate(angle,expand=True)
                data=io.BytesIO(); image.save(data,format='PNG')
                p.replace_image(xref,stream=data.getvalue())
        self.change(op)

    @staticmethod
    def image_bytes(pdf,xref):
        data=pdf.extract_image(xref)
        if data.get('smask'):
            pix=fitz.Pixmap(fitz.Pixmap(pdf,xref),fitz.Pixmap(pdf,data['smask']))
            return pix.tobytes('png')
        return data['image']

    def relocate_text(self,page,old,target,text,size=12,color=(0,0,0)):
        def op(pdf):
            p=pdf[page];p.add_redact_annot(old,fill=False);p.apply_redactions(images=0,graphics=0)
            if p.insert_textbox(target,text,fontsize=size,color=color)<0:raise ValueError('The text does not fit in the destination box.')
        self.change(op)

    def extract_pages(self, pages, path):
        """Export selected pages in the supplied order and retain source encryption."""
        if self.path and os.path.realpath(self.path) == os.path.realpath(path):
            raise ValueError('Choose a different file to avoid replacing the source PDF.')
        with fitz.open() as output:
            for page in pages:
                output.insert_pdf(self.pdf, from_page=page, to_page=page)
            self.write_pdf(output, path, self.password)

    def edit_page_range(self, pages, action):
        selected = set(pages)
        if not selected or any(page < 0 or page >= len(self.pdf) for page in selected):
            raise ValueError('Select at least one valid page.')
        if action == 'delete':
            remaining = [page for page in range(len(self.pdf)) if page not in selected]
            if not remaining:
                raise ValueError('A document must contain at least one page.')
            self.change(lambda pdf: pdf.select(remaining))
            return
        if action not in ('clockwise', 'counterclockwise'):
            raise ValueError('Unknown page action.')
        degrees = 90 if action == 'clockwise' else -90

        def rotate(pdf):
            for index in selected:
                page = pdf[index]
                page.set_rotation((page.rotation + degrees) % 360)

        self.change(rotate)

    def split(self, folder, pages_per_file):
        """Write protected parts when the source is protected."""
        if pages_per_file < 1:
            raise ValueError('Choose at least one page per file.')
        folder = Path(folder)
        stem = Path(self.path).stem if self.path else 'document'
        ranges = [
            (start, min(start + pages_per_file, len(self.pdf)))
            for start in range(0, len(self.pdf), pages_per_file)
        ]
        destinations = [folder / f'{stem}-pages-{start + 1}-{end}.pdf' for start, end in ranges]
        if any(os.path.lexists(path) for path in destinations):
            raise ValueError('Output files already exist. Choose another folder.')

        created = []
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=folder) as staging:
            try:
                for (start, end), path in zip(ranges, destinations):
                    staged = Path(staging) / path.name
                    with fitz.open() as part:
                        part.insert_pdf(self.pdf, from_page=start, to_page=end - 1)
                        self.write_pdf(part, staged, self.password)
                    # Exclusive creation prevents overwriting files added during export.
                    with staged.open('rb') as source, open(
                        path, 'xb', opener=lambda name, flags: os.open(name, flags, 0o600),
                    ) as target:
                        created.append(path)
                        shutil.copyfileobj(source, target)
                    staged.unlink()
            except Exception:
                for path in created:
                    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                raise
        return destinations


def parse_page_ranges(selection, page_count):
    """Convert comma-separated, one-based page ranges to ordered page indices."""
    import re

    pages = {}
    for part in selection.split(','):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'\s*([0-9]+)(?:\s*-\s*([0-9]+))?\s*', part)
        if not match:
            raise ValueError('Enter page numbers or ranges, for example 1, 3-5.')
        first = int(match[1])
        last = int(match[2] or first)
        if not 1 <= first <= last <= page_count:
            raise ValueError(f'Use ascending page ranges between 1 and {page_count}.')
        for page in range(first - 1, last):
            pages[page] = None
    return list(pages)

"""Offline fonts packaged with Velqora, plus the standard PDF families."""
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import sys

STANDARD = {'Helvetica': 'helv', 'Times': 'tiro', 'Courier': 'cour'}

@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def bundled_fonts():
    assets = Path(getattr(sys, '_MEIPASS', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])) / 'assets/fonts'
    entries = {}
    for metadata in sorted(assets.glob('*/METADATA.pb')):
        label = re.search(r'^name: "([^"]+)"', metadata.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), re.M)
        path = next(metadata.parent.glob('*.ttf'), None)
        if label and path:
            entries[label[1]] = path
    return dict(sorted(entries.items(), key=lambda item: item[0].casefold()))

@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def available_fonts():
    fonts = dict(bundled_fonts())
    local = {
        'Arial': ('arial.ttf', 'Arial.ttf'),
        'Times New Roman': ('times.ttf', 'Times New Roman.ttf'),
        'Verdana': ('verdana.ttf', 'Verdana.ttf'),
        'Georgia': ('georgia.ttf', 'Georgia.ttf'),
        'Calibri': ('calibri.ttf', 'Calibri.ttf'),
    }
    roots = [Path('/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental'), Path('/Library/Fonts'),
             Path.home() / 'Library/Fonts']
    if sys.platform == 'win32':
        roots = [Path(os.environ.get('WINDIR', r'C:\Windows')) / 'Fonts']
    for name, filenames in local.items():
        path = next((folder / filename for folder in roots for filename in filenames
                     if (folder / filename).is_file()), None)
        if path:
            fonts[name] = path
    return fonts

def show_help_center(window):
    dialog = QDialog(window)
    dialog.setWindowTitle('Velqora PDF Help Center')
    dialog.resize(820, 560)
    dialog.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DeleteOnClose)
    layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)
    layout.setContentsMargins(22, 20, 22, 20)
    title = QLabel('Help Center')
    title.setObjectName('heading')
    layout.addWidget(title)
    search = QLineEdit()
    search.setPlaceholderText('Search articles, tools or shortcuts')
    search.setAccessibleName('Search help articles')
    layout.addWidget(search)
    body = QHBoxLayout()
    layout.addLayout(body, 1)
    topics = QListWidget()
    topics.setAccessibleName('Help articles')
    topics.setFixedWidth(252)
    topics.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
    body.addWidget(topics)
    article = QTextBrowser()
    article.setObjectName('helpArticle')
    body.addWidget(article, 1)

    def show_topic(item, _previous):
        if item:
            heading, paragraphs = ARTICLES[item.data(Qt.UserRole)]
            article.setHtml('<h1>' + escape(heading) + '</h1>' +
                            ''.join('<p>' + escape(line) + '</p>' for line in paragraphs))
        else:
            article.setPlainText('No matching articles. Try a different search.')

    def filter_topics(query):
        terms = query.casefold().split()
        topics.clear()
        for index, (heading, paragraphs) in enumerate(ARTICLES):
            content = ' '.join((heading, *paragraphs)).casefold()
            if all(term in content for term in terms):
                item = QListWidgetItem(heading)
                item.setData(Qt.UserRole, index)
                topics.addItem(item)
        if topics.count():
            topics.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            show_topic(None, None)

    topics.currentItemChanged.connect(show_topic)
    search.textChanged.connect(filter_topics)
    filter_topics('')
    dialog.show()
    search.setFocus()
    return dialog

"""Launch Services integration for the bundled macOS application."""
import ctypes
from pathlib import Path
import sys

BUNDLE_ID = 'org.velqora.pdf'
PDF_TYPE = 'com.adobe.pdf'
VIEWER_ROLE = 2
ALL_ROLES = 0xFFFFFFFF
UTF8 = 0x08000100


def app_bundle():
    if sys.platform != 'darwin' or not getattr(sys, 'frozen', False):
        return None
    bundle = Path(sys.executable).resolve().parents[2]
    return bundle if bundle.suffix == '.app' else None


def pdf_handler(make_default=False):
    """Return whether Velqora is the current PDF opener."""
    if app_bundle() is None:
        raise RuntimeError('Open the installed Velqora PDF app to change the default.')
    launch = ctypes.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/CoreServices')
    cf = ctypes.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation')
    ref = ctypes.c_void_p

    cf.CFStringCreateWithCString.argtypes = [ref, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint32]
    cf.CFStringCreateWithCString.restype = ref
    cf.CFEqual.argtypes = [ref, ref]
    cf.CFEqual.restype = ctypes.c_ubyte
    cf.CFRelease.argtypes = [ref]
    cf.CFRelease.restype = None
    launch.LSCopyDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType.argtypes = [ref, ctypes.c_uint32]
    launch.LSCopyDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType.restype = ref
    launch.LSSetDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType.argtypes = [ref, ctypes.c_uint32, ref]
    launch.LSSetDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType.restype = ctypes.c_int32

    references = []
    try:
        for value in (PDF_TYPE, BUNDLE_ID):
            string = cf.CFStringCreateWithCString(None, value.encode('utf-8'), UTF8)
            if not string:
                raise RuntimeError('Could not allocate a Launch Services string.')
            references.append(string)
        pdf_type, bundle_id = references
        if make_default:
            status = launch.LSSetDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType(pdf_type, ALL_ROLES, bundle_id)
            if status:
                raise RuntimeError(f'macOS returned Launch Services error {status}.')
        current = launch.LSCopyDefaultRoleHandlerForContentType(pdf_type, VIEWER_ROLE)
        if current:
            references.append(current)
            return bool(cf.CFEqual(current, bundle_id))
        return False
    finally:
        for item in references:
            cf.CFRelease(item)

"""Velqora PDF — native Qt desktop editor, AGPL-3.0-or-later."""
import sys, os, json
if __name__=="__main__" and "--velqora-worker" in sys.argv:
    from worker_engine import cli
    sys.exit(cli(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--velqora-worker")+1]))
from pathlib import Path
import fitz
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QRectF, QTimer, QSize, QUrl
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QImage, QPixmap, QColor, QPainter, QPainterPath, QPen, QKeySequence, QIcon, QDesktopServices
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (QApplication,QMainWindow,QWidget,QVBoxLayout,QHBoxLayout,
    QFileDialog,QMessageBox,QInputDialog,QTabWidget,QSplitter,QListWidget,QListWidgetItem,
    QGraphicsView,QGraphicsScene,QMenu,QToolBar,QComboBox,QLabel,QPushButton,QAbstractItemView,
    QScrollArea,QColorDialog,QDialog,QDialogButtonBox,QFormLayout,QLineEdit,QSpinBox,QPlainTextEdit)
