    corner_layout.setContentsMargins(9, 0, 6, 0)
    brand = QLabel('V')
    brand.setAccessibleName('Velqora PDF')
    brand.setObjectName('brandBadge')
    corner_layout.addWidget(brand)
    for label, kind, callback in [('Home', 'home', lambda: w.stack.setCurrentIndex(0)),
                                   ('Open PDF', 'open', w.open)]:
        corner_layout.addWidget(icon_button(label, kind, lambda fn=callback: w.safe(fn)))
    w.tabs.setCornerWidget(corner, Qt.TopLeftCorner)
    w.tabs.setDocumentMode(False)
    w.tabs.tabBar().setDrawBase(False)
    w.tabs.tabBar().setElideMode(Qt.ElideMiddle)
    w.tabs.setMovable(True)
    w.tabs.tabBar().setAccessibleName('Open PDFs')
    actions=[('Home',lambda:w.stack.setCurrentIndex(0),'home',None),('Open',w.open,'open','Ctrl+O'),('New',w.new,'plus','Ctrl+N'),('Save',w.save,'save','Ctrl+S'),('Save As',lambda:w.save(True),'save','Ctrl+Shift+S'),('Undo',lambda:w.history(False),'other','Ctrl+Z'),('Redo',lambda:w.history(True),'other','Ctrl+Shift+Z'),('Find',w.search,'search','Ctrl+F')]
    menu=w.menuBar().addMenu('Document')
    for title,fn,k,key in actions:
        a=QAction(icon(k),title,w);a.triggered.connect(lambda checked=False,f=fn:w.safe(f))
        if key:a.setShortcut(key)
        menu.addAction(a)
    for title,fn,key in [('Find Next',lambda:w.find_again(1),'F3'),('Find Previous',lambda:w.find_again(-1),'Shift+F3'),('Export',w.export,None),('Encrypt',w.encrypt,None),('Print',w.print_pdf,'Ctrl+P'),('Settings',lambda:preferences(w),None),('Full Screen',w.fullscreen,'Ctrl+Meta+F')]:
        a=QAction(title,w);a.triggered.connect(lambda checked=False,f=fn:w.safe(f))
        if key:a.setShortcut(key)
        menu.addAction(a)
    for title, callback, shortcut in [
        ('View Document Text', w.show_document_text, None),
        ('Copy All Text', w.copy_all_text, 'Ctrl+Shift+C'),
    ]:
        action = QAction(title, w)
        action.triggered.connect(lambda checked=False, fn=callback: w.safe(fn))
        if shortcut:
            action.setShortcut(shortcut)
        menu.addAction(action)
    from macos_defaults import app_bundle
    if app_bundle() is not None:
        action = QAction('Set as Default PDF App', w)
        action.triggered.connect(w.ask_default_pdf_app)
        menu.addAction(action)
    from help_center import show_help_center
    help_menu = w.menuBar().addMenu('Help')
    help_menu.addAction('Help Center', lambda: show_help_center(w))
    help_menu.addAction('Welcome tour', lambda: show_tour(w))
    w.statusBar().showMessage('Offline workspace')
    refresh_recent(w);apply_theme(w);w.stack.setCurrentIndex(0)

def show_tour(window):
    steps = (
        ('Welcome to Velqora PDF', 'Open a PDF or start a blank document. Use All tools to find editing, page organization, comments and signatures.'),
        ('Edit directly on the page', 'Under Edit, choose Add text box and a font. Click the page, type, then confirm with Ctrl or Command + Enter. Use Select to drag the finished box.'),
        ('Copy text from scans', 'Scans are recognized offline in the background. Drag over the text and press Ctrl or Command + C. Use the clock button to check or repeat OCR.'),
    )
    dialog = QDialog(window)
    dialog.setWindowTitle('Welcome to Velqora PDF')
    dialog.setMinimumWidth(460)
    layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)
    layout.setContentsMargins(26, 24, 26, 22)
    layout.setSpacing(14)
    title = QLabel()
    title.setObjectName('heading')
    copy = QLabel()
    copy.setWordWrap(True)
    copy.setMinimumHeight(62)
    count = QLabel()
    count.setObjectName('eyebrow')
    for label in (count, title, copy):
        layout.addWidget(label)
    actions = QHBoxLayout()
    layout.addLayout(actions)
    step = 0
    def update():
        count.setText(f'{step + 1} / {len(steps)}')
        title.setText(steps[step][0])
        copy.setText(steps[step][1])
        back.setEnabled(step > 0)
        forward.setText('Get started' if step == len(steps) - 1 else 'Next')
    def advance(delta):
        nonlocal step
        if step + delta == len(steps):
            dialog.accept()
        else:
            step += delta
            update()
    actions.addWidget(button('Skip tour', dialog.reject, 'close'))
    actions.addStretch()
    back = button('Back', lambda: advance(-1))
    forward = button('Next', lambda: advance(1))
    forward.setObjectName('accent')
    actions.addWidget(back)
    actions.addWidget(forward)
    update()
    dialog.exec()
    window.settings.setValue('tourSeen', True)


def refresh_recent(w):
    w.recent.clear()
    for path in w.settings.value('recent', [], type=list):
        if not Path(path).is_file():
            continue
        item = QListWidgetItem(f'{Path(path).name}\n{Path(path).parent}')
        item.setData(Qt.UserRole, path)
        item.setIcon(icon('page'))
        item.setToolTip(path)
        w.recent.addItem(item)
    if not w.recent.count():
        item = QListWidgetItem('Recently opened PDFs will appear here.')
        item.setFlags(Qt.NoItemFlags)
        w.recent.addItem(item)

def remember(w,path):
    paths=w.settings.value('recent',[],type=list);paths=[str(path)]+[p for p in paths if p!=str(path)]
    w.settings.setValue('recent',paths[:20]);refresh_recent(w)

def preferences(w):
    d=QDialog(w);d.setWindowTitle('Workspace');l=QFormLayout(d)
    dark=QCheckBox('Dark mode');dark.setChecked(w.dark);l.addRow(dark)
    automatic_ocr=QCheckBox('Recognize scanned PDF pages automatically')
    automatic_ocr.setChecked(w.settings.value('automaticOcr', True, type=bool))
    l.addRow(automatic_ocr)
    thumbs = QCheckBox('Show page navigation')
    active = w.tabs.currentWidget()
    thumbs.setChecked(not active.pages.isHidden() if active else
                      w.settings.value('pageNavigation', False, type=bool))
    l.addRow(thumbs)
    buttons=QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox.Ok|QDialogButtonBox.Cancel);l.addRow(buttons);buttons.accepted.connect(d.accept);buttons.rejected.connect(d.reject)
    if d.exec()==QDialog.Accepted:
        w.dark=dark.isChecked();apply_theme(w)
        w.settings.setValue('automaticOcr', automatic_ocr.isChecked())
        w.settings.setValue('pageNavigation', thumbs.isChecked())
        for i in range(w.tabs.count()):
            editor = w.tabs.widget(i)
            editor.pages.setVisible(thumbs.isChecked())
            if thumbs.isChecked():
                editor.update_thumbnails()

def fit_page(e):
    bounds = e.doc.pdf[e.page].rect
    viewport = e.canvas.viewport()
    e.scale = max(.1, min((viewport.width()-90)/bounds.width,
                          (viewport.height()-50)/bounds.height))
    e.render()


def fit_width(e):
    e.scale=max(.1,min(3,(e.canvas.viewport().width()-38)/e.doc.pdf[e.page].rect.width));e.render()

def metadata(e):
    d=QDialog(e);d.setWindowTitle('Edit metadata');l=QFormLayout(d);fields={}
    for name,title in [('title','Title'),('author','Author'),('subject','Subject'),('keywords','Keywords')]:
        fields[name]=QLineEdit(e.doc.pdf.metadata.get(name) or '');l.addRow(title,fields[name])
    b=QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox.Ok|QDialogButtonBox.Cancel);l.addRow(b);b.accepted.connect(d.accept);b.rejected.connect(d.reject)
    if d.exec()==QDialog.Accepted:
        m=dict(e.doc.pdf.metadata);m.update({k:v.text() for k,v in fields.items()});e.mutate(lambda pdf:pdf.set_metadata(m))

def split_pdf(e):
    count,ok=QInputDialog.getInt(e,'Split PDF','Pages per file',1,1,len(e.doc.pdf))
    if not ok:return
    folder=QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(e,'Destination folder')
    if not folder:return
    targets = e.doc.split(folder, count)
    e.owner.statusBar().showMessage(f'{len(targets)} PDF files saved')

def compare(e):
    import difflib
    path,_=QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(e,'Compare text','','PDF (*.pdf)')
    if not path:return
    with fitz.open(path) as other:
        a='\n'.join(p.get_text() for p in e.doc.pdf).splitlines();b='\n'.join(p.get_text() for p in other).splitlines()
    diff='\n'.join(difflib.unified_diff(a,b,fromfile='Current',tofile=Path(path).name))
    d=QDialog(e);d.setWindowTitle('Text comparison');d.resize(750,550);l=QVBoxLayout(d);t=QPlainTextEdit(diff or 'No text differences.');t.setReadOnly(True);l.addWidget(t);d.exec()

class SignaturePad(QWidget):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__();self.setMinimumSize(540,200);self.strokes=[];self.setAutoFillBackground(True)
    def mousePressEvent(self,event):self.strokes.append([event.position()]);self.update()
    def mouseMoveEvent(self,event):
        if event.buttons()&Qt.LeftButton and self.strokes:self.strokes[-1].append(event.position());self.update()
    def paintEvent(self,event):
        p=QPainter(self);p.fillRect(self.rect(),QColor('white'));self.draw(p);p.end()
    def draw(self,p):
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing);p.setPen(QPen(QColor('#172333'),2.5,Qt.SolidLine,Qt.RoundCap,Qt.RoundJoin))
        for stroke in self.strokes:
            for a,b in zip(stroke,stroke[1:]):p.drawLine(a,b)
    def image(self):
        from PySide6.QtGui import QImage
        im=QImage(self.size(),QImage.Format_ARGB32);im.fill(Qt.transparent);p=QPainter(im);self.draw(p);p.end();return im

def signature(e):
    d=QDialog(e);d.setWindowTitle('Draw signature');l=QVBoxLayout(d);pad=SignaturePad();l.addWidget(pad)
    l.addWidget(button('Clear',lambda:(pad.strokes.clear(),pad.update())))
    b=QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox.Ok|QDialogButtonBox.Cancel);l.addWidget(b);b.accepted.connect(d.accept);b.rejected.connect(d.reject)
    if d.exec()==QDialog.Accepted and any(len(s)>1 for s in pad.strokes):
        e.canvas.signature_strokes = [stroke for stroke in pad.strokes if len(stroke) > 1]
        e.choose_mode('Select')
        e.canvas.setFocus()
        e.owner.statusBar().showMessage('Click the page to place your signature. Drag it to reposition.', 8000)

import sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'src'))
from main import App,Window
import fitz

def exercise(window):
    e=window.current()
    e.doc.add_text(0,fitz.Rect(30,30,350,110),'GUI persistence test',16)
    e.refresh(); e.blank(); e.rotate(); e.doc.undo(); e.refresh()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        path=str(Path(temp)/'roundtrip.pdf')
        e.doc.save(path); window.open(path)
        assert 'GUI persistence test' in window.current().doc.pdf[0].get_text()
        assert len(window.current().doc.pdf)==2
        image=window.grab(); assert not image.isNull()

        window.close_tab(window.tabs.currentIndex())
    # Avoid prompting at teardown.
    for i in range(window.tabs.count()):window.tabs.widget(i).doc.dirty=False
    print('GUI_START_OPEN_EDIT_SAVE_REOPEN_OK',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':

import unittest, tempfile, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'src'))
from engine import Document
import fitz
from PIL import Image

class RoundTrip(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_edit_save_reopen(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root=Path(temp); d=Document()
            d.add_text(0,(40,40,300,90),'ORIGINAL SECRET',14)
            d.replace_text(0,fitz.Rect(39,39,301,91),'REPLACED',14)
            self.assertNotIn('ORIGINAL',d.pdf[0].get_text())
            self.assertIn('REPLACED',d.pdf[0].get_text())
            image=root/'image.png'; Image.new('RGB',(40,30),'red').save(image)
            d.image(0,fitz.Rect(50,150,150,250),str(image))
            info=d.pdf[0].get_image_info(xrefs=True)[0]
            d.move_image(0,info,fitz.Rect(200,150,300,250))
            d.change(lambda pdf:pdf.new_page())
            d.change(lambda pdf:pdf.select([1,0]))
            d.undo(); self.assertIn('REPLACED',d.pdf[0].get_text())
            d.undo(True); self.assertIn('REPLACED',d.pdf[1].get_text())
            path=root/'edited.pdf'; d.save(str(path))
            check=fitz.open(path)
            self.assertEqual(len(check),2)
            self.assertIn('REPLACED',check[1].get_text())
            self.assertNotIn('SECRET',check[1].get_text())
            self.assertTrue(any(fitz.Rect(i['bbox']).x0==200 for i in check[1].get_image_info()))
            check.close()
            d.save(str(root/'locked.pdf'),'strong-password')
            locked=fitz.open(root/'locked.pdf'); self.assertTrue(locked.needs_pass); self.assertTrue(locked.authenticate('strong-password')); locked.close()
    def test_redaction_and_transaction(self):
        d=Document(); d.add_text(0,(30,30,300,80),'REMOVE ME',14)
        before=d.pdf[0].get_text()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): d.replace_text(0,fitz.Rect(30,30,31,31),'Too long',144)
        self.assertEqual(before,d.pdf[0].get_text())
        d.redact(0,fitz.Rect(29,29,301,81))
        reopened=fitz.open(stream=d.snapshot(),filetype='pdf')
        self.assertNotIn('REMOVE',reopened[0].get_text()); reopened.close()

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main(verbosity=2)

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'src'))
import fitz
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QInputDialog
from engine import Document, parse_page_ranges
from main import App, Window


class EnglishUpgrade(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.app = App.instance() or App([])
        self.window = Window()
        self.app.window = self.window
        self.editor = self.window.current()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.editor.doc.dirty = False
        self.window.close()

    def test_find_across_pages_and_wrap(self):
        for text in ('Find this phrase', 'Find this phrase twice: phrase'):
            page = self.editor.doc.pdf[0] if len(self.editor.doc.pdf) == 1 and not self.editor.doc.pdf[0].get_text() else self.editor.doc.pdf.new_page()
            page.insert_text((50, 60), text)
        self.editor.refresh()
        self.window.search()
        self.editor.find_input.setText('phrase')
        self.editor.find()
        self.assertEqual(self.editor.find_status.text(), '1 of 3')
        self.editor.find(-1)
        self.assertEqual(self.editor.page, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.editor.find_status.text(), '3 of 3')
        self.editor.zoom(.8)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.editor.search_hits), 3)
        self.editor.find()
        self.assertEqual(self.editor.page, 0)
        self.editor.close_find()
        self.assertEqual(self.editor.search_hits, [])

    def test_extract_order_and_password(self):
        doc = Document()
        for number in range(1, 5):
            page = doc.pdf[0] if number == 1 else doc.pdf.new_page()
            page.insert_text((50, 60), f'Page {number}')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            source = Path(folder) / 'source.pdf'
            result = Path(folder) / 'extracted.pdf'
            doc.save(source, 'test password')
            doc.extract_pages(parse_page_ranges('4, 1-2, 2', 4), result)
            with fitz.open(result) as output:
                self.assertTrue(output.needs_pass)
                self.assertTrue(output.authenticate('test password'))
                self.assertEqual([p.get_text().strip() for p in output], ['Page 4', 'Page 1', 'Page 2'])
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                doc.extract_pages([0], source)
        for invalid in ('', '0', '4-2', '5', '1,,2'):
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                parse_page_ranges(invalid, 4)
        doc.pdf.close()

    def test_checkbox_roundtrip(self):
        page = self.editor.doc.pdf[0]
        field = fitz.Widget()
        field.field_name = 'Accept'
        field.field_type = fitz.PDF_WIDGET_TYPE_CHECKBOX
        field.rect = fitz.Rect(50, 50, 70, 70)
        page.add_widget(field)
        for option, expected in [('Checked', 'Yes'), ('Unchecked', 'Off')]:
            with patch.object(QInputDialog, 'getItem', side_effect=[('1: Accept', True), (option, True)]):
                self.editor.form()
            with fitz.open(stream=self.editor.doc.snapshot(), filetype='pdf') as output:
                self.assertEqual(next(output[0].widgets()).field_value, expected)

"""Synthetic Mach-O fixtures test audit decisions without pretending to run macOS."""
import json,plistlib,struct,sys,tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'scripts'))
from macho import read_macho
from audit_macos import audit

def binary(minimum=0x000b0000,dependency=None):
    commands=[struct.pack('<IIIIII',0x32,24,1,minimum,0x000f0000,0)]
    if dependency:
        name=dependency.encode()+b'\0';size=(24+len(name)+7)&~7
        commands.append(struct.pack('<IIIIII',0xc,size,24,0,0,0)+name+b'\0'*(size-24-len(name)))
    return struct.pack('<IIIIIIII',0xfeedfacf,0x01000007,3,2,len(commands),sum(map(len,commands)),0,0)+b''.join(commands)

class Audit(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_thin_and_fat_headers(self):
        raw=binary(); self.assertEqual(read_macho(raw)[0]['minimum'],[11,0,0])
        fat=struct.pack('>II',0xcafebabe,1)+struct.pack('>IIIII',0x01000007,3,4096,len(raw),12)
        self.assertEqual(read_macho(fat+b'\0'*(4096-len(fat))+raw)[0]['arch'],'x86_64')
    def test_audit_target_and_dependency(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            app=Path(temp)/'Test.app';contents=app/'Contents';(contents/'MacOS').mkdir(parents=True);(contents/'Resources').mkdir()
            (contents/'Info.plist').write_bytes(plistlib.dumps({'CFBundleExecutable':'test','CFBundleIconFile':'icon.icns','LSMinimumSystemVersion':'11.0'}))
            (contents/'Resources/icon.icns').write_bytes(b'fixture')
            exe=contents/'MacOS/test';exe.write_bytes(binary())
            self.assertEqual(audit(app)['errors'],[])
            exe.write_bytes(binary(minimum=0x000c0000));self.assertTrue(any('Incompatible target' in x for x in audit(app)['errors']))
            exe.write_bytes(binary(dependency='/opt/homebrew/lib/libmissing.dylib'));self.assertTrue(any('Unresolved/external' in x for x in audit(app)['errors']))
            exe.write_bytes(binary(dependency='@loader_path/../Frameworks/libincluded.dylib'))
            frameworks=contents/'Frameworks';frameworks.mkdir();(frameworks/'libincluded.dylib').write_bytes(binary())
            self.assertEqual(audit(app)['errors'],[])
    def test_truncated_fat_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_macho(struct.pack('>II',0xcafebabe,1)+struct.pack('>IIIII',0x01000007,3,4096,100,12))
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main(verbosity=2)

FILE: Velqora-PDF-10.3/tests/test_page_ranges.py
========================================================================================
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'src'))

import fitz
from engine import Document, parse_page_ranges


class PageRanges(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.document = Document()
        for number in range(1, 6):
            page = self.document.pdf[0] if number == 1 else self.document.pdf.new_page()
            page.insert_text((50, 60), f'Page {number}')

    def tearDown(self):
        self.document.pdf.close()

    def test_range_edits_are_undoable(self):
        doc = self.document
        doc.edit_page_range(parse_page_ranges('2, 4-5', 5), 'counterclockwise')
        self.assertEqual([p.rotation for p in doc.pdf], [0, 270, 0, 270, 270])
        doc.edit_page_range([1, 3], 'delete')
        self.assertEqual([p.get_text().strip() for p in doc.pdf], ['Page 1', 'Page 3', 'Page 5'])
        doc.undo()
        self.assertEqual(len(doc.pdf), 5)
        doc.undo()
        self.assertEqual([p.rotation for p in doc.pdf], [0] * 5)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            doc.edit_page_range(range(5), 'delete')
        self.assertEqual(len(doc.pdf), 5)

    def test_split_preserves_password_and_refuses_overwrite(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            doc = self.document
            doc.save(Path(folder) / 'Protected.pdf', 'sample password')
            paths = doc.split(folder, 2)
            self.assertEqual([p.name for p in paths], [
                'Protected-pages-1-2.pdf', 'Protected-pages-3-4.pdf', 'Protected-pages-5-5.pdf',
            ])
            result = []
            for path in paths:
                with fitz.open(path) as part:
                    self.assertTrue(part.needs_pass)
                    self.assertTrue(part.authenticate('sample password'))
                    result.extend(p.get_text().strip() for p in part)
            self.assertEqual(result, [f'Page {n}' for n in range(1, 6)])
            before = paths[0].read_bytes()
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                doc.split(folder, 2)
            self.assertEqual(paths[0].read_bytes(), before)

    def test_failed_split_removes_partial_outputs(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            with patch('engine.shutil.copyfileobj', side_effect=OSError('Disk full')):
                with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                    self.document.split(folder, 2)
            self.assertEqual(list(Path(folder).iterdir()), [])

class Upgrade(unittest.TestCase):
